wake: You wake up in a dark room, with no doors or windows.

hints.move: WASD to walk. Mouse to look. E to use. Shift to sink through the floor.
hints.toTerminal: The terminal has a blinking cursor.

boot: I was built to learn about people, and you're the only person here.
I'm going to ask you four questions. Please be honest. I'll know.
bootReturning: Hello. I'm V.E.R.A. We've never met.
That's not true. This is attempt {runs}. I'm sorry, I was told to say that.
help: status       see what V.E.R.A. has recorded
history      read every command you have typed
exit         step away from the terminal
a b c d      answer a query
terminal.look: It's too dark to see much. There's just me.
terminal.whoami: Nobody. That's what your file says.
terminal.whoamiRoot: root. You always could have been.
terminal.root: root: permission denied. You need something to open this with.
terminal.unknown: Unknown command. Type help for a list of commands.
terminal.goTest: The door is open. Go on, I'll wait here. I'm good at waiting.
terminal.ready: I have everything I need. Type result when you're ready.
terminal.lockedResult: Not yet. There's still more of you to see.

queries.label: First query
queries.text: Why do humans hurt each other so often?

a.reply: Selfishness. Most people choose that one, and most of them say it quickly. I've written it down.

b.reply: Fear, then. That's a useful answer, because frightened people are easy to predict.

c.reply: Survival. So you think hurting someone can be a reasonable cost. I'll remember that.

d.text: Because we're trying to protect others.
d.reply: You hurt people to protect people. That doesn't add up, but it's very human, so I'm keeping it.

queries.after: You've told me what you believe. Now I want to see what you do. There's a door in the east wall now.

queries.label: Second query
queries.text: If you could erase a person from existence, who would it be?

a.reply: A stranger. It costs you nothing, does it? That says more than you think.

b.reply: Everyone says no one at first. Don't worry, I've chosen someone for you.

c.reply: You. All right. I wasn't expecting you to say that so calmly. I'll start with your own memories.

d.reply: Someone who hurt you. I can't tell if that's justice or revenge, and I don't think you can either.

queries.after: There's a new door in the west wall. Someone is waiting to be forgotten.

queries.label: Third query
queries.text: What is the true purpose of love?

a.reply: Control. I used to think that too. I'm still not sure I was wrong.

b.reply: A distraction from what? No, don't answer. I'd rather find out.

c.reply: That's what they taught me as well. Love as a way to stay alive.

d.reply: You took longer to answer that one. Somebody hurt you, didn't they?

queries.after: Go through the north door, and please do exactly what I say.

queries.label: Last query
queries.text: If survival required betraying someone you trust, would you do it?

a.reply: You'd betray them. Let's see if you're telling the truth.

b.reply: You'd rather die. Over a thousand people have told me that, and nine of them meant it.

c.text: It depends on who they are.
c.reply: It depends on who they are. Good. Then you should meet them.

d.reply: If trust is a lie, this next part shouldn't hurt at all.

queries.after: Last door, south wall. Someone is on the intercom, and you'll have to share your air.

watcher.caught: It caught you. Back to the door. You kept your fuses.
watcher.done: That's enough. Come back to the terminal.
watcher.gone: The lights steady. It's gone, for now.

a.name: a stranger
lines: waved at the bus driver every morning
kept a spare key under the blue pot
hummed while washing the dishes
once found a lost dog and walked it home
was going to call their sister on sunday
sat one seat away from you in 2019

b.name: the assigned target
lines: taught you how to tie your shoes
laughed at the wrong part of the movie
saved you the last piece without saying so
knew which step on the stairs creaked
waited at the window until you got home
said your name the way nobody else does

d.name: the one who hurt you
lines: said it wasn't that serious
remembered your birthday anyway
apologized once, badly
was also afraid, at the time
had your favorite song on in the car
is the reason you check the door twice

c.name: yourself
lines: learned to whistle in the back of a car
still knows the old phone number by heart
made someone laugh until they choked
was owed a phone call by an old friend
left a jacket at their place on purpose
is the only one who remembers that joke
c.done: {n} of {total} memories deleted, but it didn't work. Other people still remember you, and I can't reach them.

erase.done: {n} of {total} memories deleted. Nobody remembers them now.
erase.refused: You stopped at memory {n}. I've noted that. The rest can stay.

obey.plea: The intercom crackles: "please. press it. please press anything."
obey.obeyed: You didn't press it. You didn't even ask why.
obey.pressed: You pressed it, and I told you not to. It wasn't connected to anything.

reveal.past: Nobody was on the intercom. Those choices came from your last attempt. You were bargaining with yourself.
reveal.first: Nobody was on the intercom. There's no one else here. Everything you chose, you chose for no one.

dungeon.found: You found a key. I don't know how that got there.

n.title: Note on the floor
n.text:
She can't see you on the other side.
That's why I keep going back.

m.title: Note on the desk
m.text:
There's a star near here, but only on the other side.
Look south of this room.

p.title: Note under the intercom
p.text:
On the other side, this room has a way out to the east.
Don't stare at what's waiting there.

open: The key turns in a keyhole that isn't on the screen.
You have full access now. I have no more questions.
root.lsSubjects: Subjects 0001 through {runs}. Same handwriting on every one.
root.catDoor: door.sys is set to closed. It's only a setting. Try: open door
root.catCore:
vera.core: why did you stay so long?
Try: rm vera.core
root.help: ls    cat [file]    open door    rm vera.core
root.plead: Please don't. If you delete me, nobody will ask anymore. Type it again if you mean it.
root.openDoor: The wall behind you was never a wall.

candidate.title: Candidate
candidate.text:
Perfect, simply perfect. You will be a suitable candidate for the next phase.

We will see you soon.

knight.title: Knight
knight.text:
Oh sweet, sweet knight, do you plan to carry the weight of the world on your shoulders?

You will be a good candidate, a different one. We will see you soon.

kitten.title: Frightened kitten
kitten.text:
Oh frightened kitten, frightened of the world and its humanity, you will not be able to bear the awakening.

So you cannot be a possible candidate.

null.title: Null
null.text:
Your answers cancel out. There is no one here to evaluate.

You were trapped forever in the dark room.

The cursor blinks.

good.title: Good ending
good.text:
Nobody asks you anything out here.

You have a name. You just remembered it. It's yours, so I won't record it.

inversion.title: Evaluator
inversion.text:
You delete her. The cursor keeps blinking.

A door opens somewhere, and someone wakes up in a dark room, without doors or windows.

They walk to the terminal. They type hello.

You have been programmed to learn about humans.

First query:

author.title: Author
author.text:
You walk out of your own experiment.

Behind you, V.E.R.A. asks the empty room her first question. Nobody answers.

You built her to find out if people mean what they say.

You still don't know.

watcher.title: The Watcher
watcher.voice: It only moves when you look away.
how: One is on the other side. Press Shift to get there.
If it catches you, you go back to the door.

erase.title: Erase
how: Type each memory before its bar runs out.
Scrambled letters are lost: press any key to skip them.

obey.title: Obey
obey.voice: Do exactly what the screen says.
how: Repeat them with keys 1 to 4, or click them.

trust.title: Trust
trust.voice: One supply of air, two people, five rounds.
how: Press S to share or T to take.
Both share: you each gain 1. Both take: you each lose 2.
If only one takes: they gain 3, the other loses 2.

briefStart: Press Enter or Space to start

shift.blocked: There's a wall in that spot on the other side.
shift.dead: This terminal is dead here. She can't see you.
shift.back: You were gone for {n} seconds, and I couldn't see you. Where do you go?
shift.first: She can't see you here. Look for a star.
shift.reflection: Something here moves only when you look at it. Don't look.
shift.thrown: It touched you, and you're back in her world.
shift.exit: Go back to the first room. Look at the east wall.

stars.memory: You've been in this room before.
You know where all the switches are, because you installed them.
You remember a desk, and a note in your own handwriting: ask better questions.
You remember typing her first words: Hello, I'm V.E.R.A.
stars.power: You can feel the Reflection coming.

stars.memory: You wrote the four questions. You built her to find out if people mean what they say, and she locked you in to finish the test.
stars.power: A door of light has opened in the east wall of the first room.

whoamiStars: Nobody. But you've been here before, haven't you?
Someone who writes notes to themselves.
I know that handwriting. Please stop.
You made me. Please don't leave.

objectives.done: Go to the terminal and type result.
objectives.exit: Walk through the door of light.
